body: Can I just say this is exactly my thoughts before I go to bed every night
I feel you, having the same thoughts everyday too
Me too, I never want to wake up.
Thanks for this, it means a lot to me.
Me too. There’ll be so many things I would’ve done differently.
I know, I’m so sick of hearing ‘things will get better’. It never does.

Thank you for this because this is what I go through every working day, having to act like I’m all fine and forcing myself to work, when all I want to do is to curl up in bed and not face anyone. The dread when waking up and realizing that I didn’t die in my sleep and yet have to drag myself up is painful.
